newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dakota plane reported crashed off Dutch coast.
newsitem.headline: Dakota plane reported crashed off Dutch coast.

text.p: A DC-3 Dakota aircraft carrying 35 passengers crashed into the North Sea about 30 miles west of the Dutch town of Den Helder on Wednesday afternoon, ANP news agency said.
It said the coast guard had confirmed the crash involving the propeller-driven vintage aircraft and said seven lifeboats were underway.
A spokesman at the coastguard centre in Ijmuiden told Dutch radio a Dakota aircraft believed to be carrying 35 people had crashed into the North Sea at around 1445 GMT.
He said the coastguard had been told of the incident by military air traffic control but had few early details.
He said a number of bodies had been sighted in the water close to the crash site and that one passenger had been taken to hospital.
